description: Make the boundary between the pale sandy strand and the flat green band below it read as one coastline painting. Remove the straight horizontal edge and replace it with a natural transition: the sand thinning into dune grass, patches of scrub, driftwood and low coastal meadow, uneven and hand-drawn, so the beach fades into the green gradually. Keep the existing sand and grass palettes and the same pixel-art hand as the delta above. No straight horizontal line, no new buildings, roads or rivers.
